nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 512$ be a natural number and $N = 2n + 2$. For a natural number $x$ write $x\#$ for the primorial of $x$, the product of all primes $p \le x$, and let $L = \lfloor \log_2 N \rfloor$. Then $n \cdot \lfloor N/3 \rfloor\# \cdot \prod_{m=2}^{L} \lfloor N^{1/m} \rfloor\# < 4^n$.
nodes.title: Central Erdős layer estimate

nodes.summary: Let $N$ and $r$ be natural numbers. For a natural number $x$ write $x\#$ for the primorial of $x$, the product of all primes $p \le x$. Let $L = \lfloor \log_2 N \rfloor$, with $L = 0$ when $N = 0$, and let $P = 1$ if $L = 0$ and $P = r\# \cdot \prod_{m=2}^{L} \lfloor N^{1/m} \rfloor\#$ if $L \ge 1$. Then $P \le 4^{r + \lfloor \sqrt{N} \rfloor + \lfloor N^{1/3} \rfloor L}$.
nodes.title: Three-layer power-of-four bound for the Erdős layer product

nodes.summary: Let $N$ and $r$ be natural numbers. For a natural number $x$ write $x\#$ for the primorial of $x$, the product of all primes $p \le x$. Let $L = \lfloor \log_2 N \rfloor$, with $L = 0$ when $N = 0$, and let $P = 1$ if $L = 0$ and $P = r\# \cdot \prod_{m=2}^{L} \lfloor N^{1/m} \rfloor\#$ if $L \ge 1$. Then $P \le 4^{r + \lfloor \sqrt{N} \rfloor L}$.

can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
